name: notification-open-last-line
description: A NotificationCard with a long free-form secondary keeps Open adjacent to the secondary text's final line at a narrow desktop content width and at phone width, never strands on a line by itself, and centers both trailing slots (Open, chevron) on that line - the flex-end cross alignment pins their 1lh wrappers to the line's end, and the glyph inside must not ride half-leading below the words.

mutation.declaration: notificationcard.module.css: remove the height:1lh (and align-items:center) from .openTrailing/.secondaryTail .chevron
mutation.note: Each slot's wrapper was reverted separately on 2026-09-11 and re-run: removing .openTrailing's height/align-items parks the Open glyph 3.7px low (both viewports), removing .secondaryTail .chevron's height parks the chevron 2.7px low (both viewports). The bare 1em Open slot (and 14px chevron box) seat flush against the line box's bottom edge under flex-end and poke below the line. The earlier mutation (change .secondaryTail display:inline-flex to display:inline, verified 2026-09-03) still fails the stranding assertion.
